definitions.gloss: explicit indication, clearly showing, making clear
definitions.explanation: To indicate or show something clearly and unambiguously, whether in writing, speech, or action. Broader than writing alone — can apply to any form of clear communication or display.

examples.japanese: ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明示|めいじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{明示|めいじ}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are obligations explicitly stated in the law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出典|しゅってん}→出典：06424_shutten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{明示|めいじ}せず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{盗用|とうよう}→盗用：23322_touyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Using someone else's writing without explicitly indicating the source constitutes plagiarism.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({明示|めいじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) or noun. Contrasts with ⟦{暗示|あんじ}→暗示：07711_anji⟧ (implicit suggestion/hinting). In legal contexts, {明示|めいじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧ means explicit consent, as opposed to {黙示|もくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧ (tacit consent).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {明示|めいじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explicitly state/show
- {明示|めいじ}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: explicit (as adjective)
- {明示|めいじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同意|どうい}→同意：05092_doui⟧: explicit consent
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{明示|めいじ}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: is explicitly indicated in ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明記|めいき}→明記：13030_meiki⟧: clearly stating in writing (specifically written)
- ⟦{暗示|あんじ}→暗示：07711_anji⟧: hint, suggestion (antonym — implicit rather than explicit)
